title: Corridor step 3 — the Central Bank of Chile confirms, and the corridor becomes ACTIVE
description: Only the Central Bank of token B may confirm. On success the pair reaches ACTIVE status and liquidity can be seeded.
notes: Gateway: Banco Central de Chile Central Bank gateway. pair_id W-CRC-CLP is the identifier every later call reuses verbatim — quote, swap, pool status, circuit breaker and liquidity commit. Never construct one: five incompatible conventions appear across the delivered artefacts and none is documented as canonical (catalogued in Toolbox/DIVERGENCES.md). This kit uses the slash-free form because the pool-status route is /api/v2/amm/pool/:pair/status — a single path segment, which an identifier containing a slash cannot occupy. The sovereign form is real and produced by the platform itself: normalizeSovereignPoolPair in scenario-b central_bank_pool_client.go rewrites W-BRL-W-ARS to W-BRL-ARS.
